## Change
Describe the behavior or document updated. Link the issue.

## Validation
List checks run and their results. Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Review

- [ ] No credentials or generated dependency folders included

- Phase and issue:
- Owner consulted before cross-area edits:

- Reviewer and evidence links:
